During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a '''mobster''' was the target of an organized crime case, and [[Unidentified organized crime witness|one]] of the mobster's employees&mdash;who was serving as a witness in the case&mdash;claimed that he had helped his boss bury a fortune on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Under Oath}}</ref>
